parent_scientific_scope: No genetic character masks, nucleotide identity, genetic distance, post-IBD turnover or empirical beta_host opened. Historical host predictor information was exposed on 2026-10-08; this is an explicit pre-genetic methodological completion, not a pre-predictor preregistration.

inputs.panel: confirmatory-only 321 species from exact deterministic prior assignment; development genetic response permanently closed
inputs.edges: exact 71,520 rows of frozen 641-species predictor CSV, subset to confirmatory species
inputs.graph: exact 642-species locality + edge geometry from SHA256-bound archive, with 1 candidate ineligible

randomization.rng: numpy default_rng (PCG64); SHA256(namespace|exact source SHA256|world class|species) truncated to first 16 hex digits as integer
randomization.spatial_basis: 8 independent 3D Gaussian random-frequency vectors, each coordinate N(0,1)/200 km, held fixed for a species, sin/cos features (16); independent Gaussian coefficients in each world

response_world.edge_ibd: 0.60 times z(log1p(chord endpoint distance in km))
response_world.host_beta_null: independent species effect N(0,0.10^2) per synthetic world
response_world.host_beta_positive: independent species effect N(0.10,0.10^2) per synthetic world
response_world.lineage_private_spatial: 0.45 times z(abs(U(node_left)-U(node_right))) per edge, where U comes from frozen species-private random Fourier basis in 3D km
response_world.iid_edge_noise: 0.65 times independent standard normal per edge
response_world.endpoint_safe_ibd: For each held-out graph edge, fit raw response versus log1p(chord-distance) on edges touching neither held-out endpoint (exact leave-two-localities-out); subtract held-out linear prediction. Minimum 5 disjoint edges; singular design is a fail-closed synthetic geometry violation.
response_world.final_estimator: Per species z(post-IBD residual) ~ z(M_host)+z(M_self)+z(D_host_0BP); ordinary least squares standardized host beta, then studentized equal-species mean across confirmatory species
response_world.calibration: Use one fixed independent 1999-world reference for evaluation and positive decisions; no leave-one-in-reference

gates.type1: Wilson 95% upper bound for null-evaluation p<=0.05 rate <=0.10
gates.positive_power: Wilson 95% lower bound for positive-world p<=0.05 rate >=0.80
gates.forbidden: No alterations after any synthetic world is inspected; no adaptive effect strength, nuisance, panel, seed, or estimator changes to rescue a failure

caution: This synthetic family evaluates the declared conditional model's behavior, not the truth of the ecological mechanism or ancient insect-host occurrence.
